name: Karpathy Guidelines
description: Behavioral checklist to avoid common LLM coding mistakes: resist overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria. TRIGGER when: about to start a non-trivial implementation, refactor, or debugging task — read before writing code; also when the user asks you to "follow the guidelines", slow down, or stop over-engineering. DO NOT TRIGGER for: trivial one-line/mechanical edits, or pure Q&A with no code changes.
